content: MSUD Maxamaid is a powdered medical food specifically designed for the dietary management of maple syrup urine disease (MSUD) in children aged 1 to 8 years. It is an orange-flavored formula that is free of isoleucine, leucine, and valine. Each 100 grams of the powder provides 25 grams of protein equivalent. The product is not intended for use in children under 1 year of age and is not suitable as the sole source of nutrition. It is also not intended for parenteral use. The intake of MSUD Maxamaid must be carefully adjusted under medical supervision to support normal growth and development. It should be consumed alongside natural protein, fluids, and other nutrients in quantities prescribed by a physician or dietitian to meet the individual’s specific requirements for isoleucine, leucine, valine, and overall nutrition. This product is not associated with any controlled studies, and no adverse effects or contraindications have been reported. It is categorized as N/A for pregnancy and lactation, as it is intended solely for pediatric use. For general safety, it is considered acceptable, with no evidence of fetal risk observed in controlled studies involving pregnant women.
